Use case: infographic-diagram. Create ONE finished Traditional Chinese public health education card, portrait 1024x1536. Match the established series: white background, bold navy title, teal subtitle pill, four vertically stacked generously spaced rounded pastel panels (mint, pale blue, pale yellow, pale pink), numbered circles 1–4, small friendly flat medical illustrations on right, large crisp readable Traditional Chinese typography on left, red warning footer and small gray source line. Professional Taiwan pharmacy education design, generous margins. All supplied text verbatim, no omissions, no extra advice. Allow line wrapping. No realistic bloody wounds, no logos, no watermark. Prioritize readable text over illustrations. Title「縫合／術後傷口，回家怎麼照顧？」Subtitle「換藥、碰水與拆線，依醫療團隊指示」
Panel 1 heading「先看清楚照護指示」text「確認何時換藥、能否淋浴、何時回診。」「縫線、傷口膠與免縫膠帶，照護方式不同。」Illustration discharge instructions.
Panel 2 heading「換藥前洗手，敷料保持清潔」text「不碰傷口或敷料內側；濕透、髒污或鬆脫時，依指示處理。」「不自行加擦藥膏或消毒藥水。」Illustration washing hands.
Panel 3 heading「保護傷口，避免拉扯」text「不摳傷口膠、不自行拉線或提早撕除免縫膠帶。」「能淋浴後也避免搓揉；未獲許可前不泡澡、游泳。」Illustration protected small closed sutured forearm wound.
Panel 4 heading「按時回診，留意每天變化」text「拆線時間依部位與癒合情況決定，不自行拆線。」「傷口裂開、紅腫擴大、疼痛增加、流膿或發燒，當天聯絡醫療團隊。」Illustration clinician.
Red footer「持續加壓仍止不住血，或傷口突然大幅裂開，立即就醫。」
Small source「資料來源：NHS 術後傷口照護」

Use case: infographic-diagram. Create ONE finished Traditional Chinese public health education card, portrait 1024x1536. Match the established series: white background, bold navy title, teal subtitle pill, four vertically stacked generously spaced rounded pastel panels (mint, pale blue, pale yellow, pale pink), numbered circles 1–4, small friendly flat medical illustrations on right, large crisp readable Traditional Chinese typography on left, red warning footer and small gray source line. Professional Taiwan pharmacy education design, generous margins. All supplied text verbatim, no omissions, no extra advice. Allow line wrapping. No realistic bloody wounds, no logos, no watermark. Prioritize readable text over illustrations. Title「糖尿病足：腳有傷口，不痛也要處理」Subtitle「每天看雙腳，發現破皮就提早求助」
Panel 1 heading「每天看腳底，也看趾縫」text「留意破皮、水泡、裂口、紅腫與滲液。」「看不到的地方，用鏡子或請家人協助。」Illustration checking sole with mirror.
Panel 2 heading「發現傷口，當天聯絡醫療人員」text「不要等到疼痛、化膿才求助。」「即使沒有破皮，單腳突然紅、熱、腫，也要儘速評估。」Illustration contacting medical team.
Panel 3 heading「先覆蓋保護，減少傷口受壓」text「用乾淨、不黏傷口的敷料暫時覆蓋。」「減少踩壓患處；已有減壓鞋或輔具，依醫囑使用。」Illustration seated patient with protected foot not weightbearing.
Panel 4 heading「避免再受傷，持續控制血糖」text「不赤腳、不泡腳、不用熱敷墊；穿鞋前檢查鞋內異物。」「不自行剪雞眼、厚繭或使用雞眼藥；按時用藥與回診。」Illustration inspecting inside a shoe.
Red footer「足部傷口合併發燒、畏寒，或腳趾發黑、突然冰冷變色，立即就醫。」
Small source「資料來源：NIDDK、NICE 糖尿病足照護指引」

Use case: infographic-diagram. Create ONE finished Traditional Chinese public health education card, portrait 1024x1536. Match the established series: white background, bold navy title, teal subtitle pill, four vertically stacked generously spaced rounded pastel panels (mint, pale blue, pale yellow, pale pink), numbered circles 1–4, small friendly flat medical illustrations on right, large crisp readable Traditional Chinese typography on left, red warning footer and small gray source line. Professional Taiwan pharmacy education design, generous margins. All supplied text verbatim, no omissions, no extra advice. Allow line wrapping. No realistic bloody wounds, no logos, no watermark. Prioritize readable text over illustrations. Title「長者皮膚撕裂傷，先保護掀起的皮」Subtitle「碰撞、摩擦或撕膠帶，都可能讓脆弱皮膚受傷」
Panel 1 heading「先止血，再輕柔清潔」text「用乾淨的不黏敷料輕壓止血。」「清潔時動作輕柔，不刷洗、不來回摩擦。」Illustration gentle pressure with nonadherent pad.
Panel 2 heading「掀起的皮，不要剪掉或撕掉」text「這片皮膚可能仍有保護作用。」「不硬拉、不自行修剪，儘早請醫療人員評估與復位。」Illustration simple non-graphic small skin flap, no scissors or pulling.
Panel 3 heading「選不黏傷口、容易移除的敷料」text「可請醫療人員評估矽膠接觸層等敷料。」「避免強黏膠帶或強黏人工皮；敷料黏住時不要硬撕。」Illustration atraumatic silicone dressing.
Panel 4 heading「保護周圍皮膚，減少再次受傷」text「完整皮膚規律保濕，可用長袖、長褲保護。」「協助移位時避免拖拉手臂，並依指示換藥與回診。」Illustration older adult wearing protective long sleeves.
Red footer「持續壓迫仍出血、傷口深大，立即就醫；紅腫擴大、流膿、發燒或皮瓣變黑，儘速評估。」
Small source「資料來源：ISTAP 2025 皮膚撕裂傷照護建議」
